* Oversee technology roadmap for sanctions screening, including model enhancements, AI/ML functionality, tuning strategies, and case‑prioritization frameworks.
* Review of Banks sanction and screening SOPs / policy/ Framework at frequent interval and recommend and advise latest development on latest regulation from the statutory bodies.
* Recommending and advising corrective measures /steps in implementation of latest rule, regulation issued / published by local as well as international statutory bodies. E.g. press release from US treasury, EU, UN, FATF etc. at BOD to check potential sanction implementation with immediate effect.
* Review of Negative list and advise the addition / deletion of the respective list basis recent development.
* Follow\-up with the respective IT team / stakeholder for deliverable of enhancement in the respective entity screening product processor.
* Own and update the Sanctions Policy, Screening Framework, and associated SOPs.
* Define QC/QA frameworks, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and timeliness of sanctions disposition
* Oversee scenario tuning for name, payment, trade, and customer screening models
* Ensure robust data\-quality governance (lists, attributes, matching logic, phonetic parameters, fuzzy matching thresholds).
* Strengthen adverse media/negative news workflows and deploy risk‑segmented screening controls.
* Ensure all sanction\-related escalations follow structured risk\-justification and documentation standards.
* Perform analysis against True / False match received through AMLOCK / entity screening product processor. Review and advise the correct disposition.
* Recommending and advising corrective actions with regards to such customers, wherein customers are dealing money laundering through trade\-based transactions or dealing with sanctioned entities, individuals or countries.
* Conduct internal and external outreach for enhanced due diligence review, adverse media news PEPs, SIE and SIP screening.
* Ensure Trade transactions and remittance are aligned with customer line of business are following applicable law, rules, regulations (local and international) and corporate policy.
* Lead Sanctions screening for customers, transactions, trade flows, wires, Swift/RTGS/NEFT, fintech partners, and correspondent banking relationships.
* Oversee sanctions list sourcing, enrichment, validation, and governance (UNSC, UAPA, WMD, UN, OFAC, EU, UK\-HMT, Ministry of JAPAN, Ministry of Singapore and applicable domestic lists).
* Manage high\-risk escalations to AML Head/PO and provide expert guidance on complex sanction cases.
* Conduct post\-incident reviews (missed matches, delayed alerts, or screening system exceptions).
* Provide sanctions advisory for new products, APIs, digital channels, and cross\-border partnerships.
* Ensure strong screening controls for UPI, cards, wallets, trade finance, and cross\-border payments.
* Maintain high levels of compliance awareness and knowledge to effectively support enhance due diligence and other related areas of responsibility.
* Update conclusion to business and involved stakeholders about existing / newly on boarded customers where risk tolerance is exceeded based on analysis.
* Escalate and recommend customers for closure to senior management, wherein customers are involved with material sanctions.
* End to End management of Trade Based Money Launder Alert Life cycle.
* Timely advice on L2 and L3 escalations
* Approvals for STR / CBWTR and other regulatory reportings.
* Lead and mentor a team of sanctions analysts, reviewers, and specialists.
* Drive resource planning, competency mapping, and skill development for sanctions specialists.
* Implement performance dashboards, case quality metrics, and productivity KPIs
* Drive a culture of compliance\-first behavior, documentation discipline, and professional integrity
* Provide specialized training on sanctions typologies, global regulatory actions, and geopolitical risk indicators
* Build Strong Relationship with Business Head, Risk, compliance and regulatory team and other stakeholders.
* Act as a bridge between technical team and business leadership to ensure alignment on priorities.


**Essential:** 
 Min 12\-15 years of experience in Banking and 4\-5 years of recent experience in managing Sanctions.
   

  

**Preferred:** 
 15 years of experience in Banking and minimum 6 years of recent experience in managing Sanctions.

title: Security & Compliance Specialist
description:
* **Company Description** 
 Jio Haptik is a leading AI\-powered customer experience platform that has been innovating since 2013, processing over 10 billion conversations and 10 million transactions across more than 10 channels in 135 languages for 500\+ enterprises. The company helps brands transition to Generative AI and deliver end\-to\-end customer experiences at scale. Haptik’s product lines, Contakt and Interakt, support both enterprises and SMEs in solving their customers’ most pressing pain points. Recognized as a Category Leader by platforms such as Gartner, G2, and Opus Research, Haptik has also won awards including “Tech Startup of the Year” in AI and “Best Chat \& Conversational Bot.” Its customers include prominent brands such as Jio, Paytm, Adani, Paisabazaar, Puma, and Whirlpool.



  





**What will you do every day?** 




 As a Security \& Compliance Consultant, you are responsible for helping the implementation of the organization’s information security and compliance programs. You will also help in implementing and reviewing data protection and privacy controls through technical, operational, and administrative measures. The ideal candidate will have good experience in Security in SaaS products, a deep understanding of regulatory requirements, and a proactive approach to managing security threats and third\-party risks; someone who enjoys security work and possesses both deep and wide expertise in the security space.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities** 



* **Develop and Implement Security \& Privacy Policies (Primary \| Must have)**
* Create and maintain comprehensive security policies and procedures for cloud environments and application security that align with organizational goals and regulatory requirements
* Ensure policies are regularly updated and communicated to relevant stakeholders; should be an SME for Enterprise Security and Privacy related activities
* **Third\-Party Risk Management (Primary \| Must have)**
* Handle the third\-party risk management activities (TPRM) covering both inbound and outbound assessments (through the Customer \& Vendor lifecycles)
* Collaborate with procurement and legal teams to ensure third\-party contracts include appropriate security and compliance requirements (this includes reviews of MSA, Bids, RFP’s)
* **Compliance Oversight (Primary \| Must have)**
* Ensure the organization’s compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, DPDP, SOC 2\); should be an SME for compliance
* Implementation of minimum 3 standards from GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, DPDP, SOC 2
* Handle the internal and external audits and manage responses to audit findings
* **Product Security Practices (Primary \| Good to have)**
* Integrate security practices into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and review the releases based on the established Secure SDLC processes
* Review the Products from time to time checking the availability of enterprise security features
* **Cloud \& Infra Security (Secondary \| Good to have)**
* Implement, review and maintain robust security controls for cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) as per the industry best practices (DevSecOps)
* Perform security reviews and hygienic\-checks on cloud environments
* **Cybersecurity (Secondary \| Good to have)**
* Knowledge on Cyber Attack Vectors, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Attack Surface Mgmt., etc.
* Adequate knowledge on Incident Response, Business Resilience and Risk Management
* **Other responsibilities**
* To act as a Security \& Privacy champion/catalyst for all functions/BUs within the Company
* Training entire staff about security and privacy best practices whenever necessary



**Experience \& Other** 
**Requirements** 



* Degree/Diploma in Computer Science / Information Technology / Cybersecurity or equivalent
* **3\-6 years** 
 of experience in information security, with a focus on compliance
* Proven track record in implementing security and compliance policies \& controls
* At least 2 years of working and implementation knowledge for any two of the compliances (ISO 27001, 27701, GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, DPDP)
* Good to have working knowledge of Cloud security practices \& involved in DevSecOps activities
* Good research mindset with a zeal to explore, learn, share, and implement
